dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_rise Not a question of "if". 
But a matter of when.

Will #Dogecoin ever gain considerable value?

- #doge is inflationary in nature and will, over time, always default back to lower value. It might reach the 2-3 $USD value level if on regular intervals big amounts of $DOGE are to be burned (creating scarcity and pushing value up). https://t.co/UHZi2o0hgT

Is it possible that #dogecoin can be just as big as #Bitcoin ? Are there any differences between the two?

- There are a variety of technical differences. Chances are slim $DOGE can become as big as #BTC as these technical differences counter ANY edge $DOGE could have long term. https://t.co/KfI1hjTv4U

Technologically, there is little difference between #dogecoin  and #Bitcoin , yet why is one called a joke and the other is called digital gold?

- All boils down to use-case and development. $DOGE was developed as a memecoin. #Bitcoin as a viable alternative which fixes tender. https://t.co/4Uq2ZRFWLL

Why can’t #dogecoin  be limited like #Bitcoin ?

- All is to be brought back to the hardwired coding of the #blockchain . #dogecoin has been programmed to have an unlimited amount to be produced. To increase its value must scarcity be created by burning the surplus of tokens. https://t.co/5y7LWjW7z4

Do you think pumping coins like #dogecoin , #ETC, and #BCH are hurting the #Crypto  community?

- Not at all. The market works in cycles. The most dominant coin tends to increase the total market value and the pumping of #altcoins is a sign of distribution. https://t.co/6IdHlDkYmE

Does this mean #dogecoin is worthless? 
Does it mean it has no significance whatsoever? 
That investors in the coin have been duped into a failed pipe-dream. 

That's a yes on the last question. 
... and a no on the first two. 

Read more about it here: 

https://t.co/wFNe0FoN5f

Why are analysts saying that #dogecoin is bad for legitimate #cryptocurrencies , and is it true?

- Truth is in the middle. Ask yourself, when investing in a professional company, do you want to be re-assured of the success of a company by a well-dressed professional or a clown? https://t.co/5irIue3EbJ
